title: Zesty Charred Vietnamese Chicken Curry
description: A keto-friendly Vietnamese dish featuring charred chicken and coconut milk, served in a banana leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, grated ginger, and garlic.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook in a skillet over medium-high heat until charred on all sides.
In a separate saucepan, heat the coconut milk over medium heat.
Add the Thai red curry paste to the coconut milk and stir to combine.
Add the cooked chicken to the curry sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Spoon the chicken and curry sauce onto banana leaves and serve.
